request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, hardware wallet support, and wallet data export improvements
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for the Eternl non-custodial Cardano light wallet, including frontend and backend maintenance and development, backend infrastructure, user support, day-to-day operations, audits, and oversight metrics.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000 at about $0.1787 per Ada to fund a 12-month operating period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposal states Eternl's annual operating cost is about $420,000, funding 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
The budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to admin, and 2% to audits.
Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
Eternl says independent fund-use audits will be performed in February 2027 and August 2027 by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team.
Eternl states it will assess repayment every December and June and use surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 to repay the treasury until $420,000 in Ada has been repaid.
Eternl claims a Pro plan priced at $96/year for personal users and $360/year for company users could cover the $420,000 annual cost if about 5,500 users, or about 4.2% of its install base, subscribe.
Eternl claims it has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs combined.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
Eternl states its main UI will not be open-source, while some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the Eternl npm organization.

summary: The proposal asks for ₳2,350,000 to fund Eternl operations for 12 months, with a stated sustainability path through paid Pro plans, public wallet custody, periodic fund-use audits, and conditional treasury repayment, but many key adoption, repayment, audit independence, feasibility, and risk claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
